name: COLTENE Holding AG
summary: COLTENE Holding AG develops, manufactures, and sells disposables, tools, and equipment for dentists and dental laboratories in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, North America, Latin America, and Asia/Oceania. The company offers restoration products, including conventional composites, bulk-fill composites, CAD/CAM solutions, core build-ups, bondings, etching gels, temporary materials, luting, curing lights, characterizations, and parapulpal pins; and endodontics products, such as cold sprays, hand files, shaping and retreatment files, endo motors, rinsing and disinfection system, drying, temporary fillings, sealers, guttapercha points, and posts and drills.
